SUMMARY: I build the frontend of a children's fashion company: the applications its shops and its wholesale clients use every day, and the internal tools that hold them up. Mostly React and TypeScript, some Angular and Ionic, all of it used by people who did not get to choose their software. I care about code that still reads well two years later, and about interfaces that ask nobody to learn something new to do their job.
REPO_SHOPPING_LIST_DESCRIPTION: Shopping list wired to several supermarket APIs and shared with your contacts.
REPO_CV_APP_DESCRIPTION: A CV built as an application, with the data kept apart from the layout.
REPO_WARDROBE_DESCRIPTION: Technical test: wardrobe catalogue with search by name, switchable grid and end-to-end tests.
REPO_DRONES_DESCRIPTION: Technical test: traffic drones over London, with a drone list and each drone's reports.
CAREER_SENIOR_DETAIL: Architecture of the store applications and mentoring the team.
CAREER_MAYORAL_DETAIL: Moved the wholesale channel to React and designed the component system.
CAREER_AGENCY_DETAIL: Custom projects for retail and tourism clients.
CARE_ACCESSIBILITY: Accessible from the first commit, not at the end.
CARE_DEPENDENCIES: No dependencies that don't pay their weight.
CARE_MOTION: Respects the system's reduced motion setting.
